INSERT INTO tg_updates (update_id, payload, topic, processed)
SELECT {{ $json.update_id }}::bigint,
       '{{ JSON.stringify($json.payload ?? {}).replace(/'/g, "''") }}'::jsonb,
       '{{ $json.topic }}', FALSE
WHERE {{ $json.update_id }}::bigint > 0
ON CONFLICT (update_id) DO NOTHING;

UPDATE tg_offset SET offset_value = GREATEST(offset_value, {{ $json.update_id + 1 }}::bigint), updated_at = NOW()
WHERE id = 1 AND {{ $json.update_id + 1 }}::bigint > 1;
